title: 30M Cell Granularity Differentiation

arms.initial_function: exact hidden-dimension partition of each existing FFN expert

continuation.mixture: 25% each; one occurrence per four-step block with deterministic shuffled order

cell_differentiation: cell profile stability versus age zero

decision_rule.differentiation_signal: final median cell specialization improves by at least 0.05 versus G=1
decision_rule.performance_guardrail: final balanced NLL ratio versus G=1 is <= 1.02
decision_rule.stability_guardrail: mean final profile cosine versus age zero is >= 0.80

interpretation_limits: Experiment 026 does not enable or test autonomous mitosis.
The symbolic and facts domains are deterministic synthetic training environments, not broad symbolic reasoning or factual-knowledge benchmarks.
The diagnostic stress score is not an endogenous biological variable and is not used to trigger growth.
A positive result supports finer cell granularity as a useful developmental substrate; it does not by itself establish full NCA self-organization.
